Historical successes confirm full-data retrain, heterogeneous GBDT blends with native categorical handling, and deterministic features all help, while the failed case (context-conditioned stacker plus 121-point threshold sweep) shows extra fitted parameters between base probabilities and labels actively hurt held-out accuracy. I therefore target the three modules that own those failure surfaces: feature representation (data_processing_and_feature_engineering), the base-learner pool (model_design), and the stacker/threshold/seed policy (training_evaluation).", "module": ["data_processing_and_feature_engineering", "model_design", "training_evaluation"], "plan": {"data_processing_and_feature_engineering": "WHAT: Extend engineer_features with a small deterministic block — coupon_x_matched_freq_num (COUPON_CODE * matched_venue_freq), social_to_matched_gap (matched_venue_freq - mean of FREQ_ORD), is_high_value_coupon (coupon in {Bar, Restaurant(20-50)}), expiration_x_time (expiration_hours * time_ord, min-max scaled to [0,1] using fixed constants, not fitted ranges), and coupon_x_distance (COUPON_CODE * distance_level) — and add reliability columns support_<key> = log1p(count) alongside each TE column. WHY: the dominant signal is coupon x habitual venue engagement x timing, currently only implicit, and sparse keys (coupon_occupation 125 levels) give magnitude without reliability, causing misleading splits; historical successes confirm deterministic interaction features and fold-safe TE lift GBDT blends. HOW: implement the products inside engineer_features using only constant maps (COUPON_CODE, FREQ_MAP, EXPIRATION_HOURS) so prepare_predict produces identical columns; extend fit_target_encoding to also record per-level counts in te_state['maps'] and transform_target_encoding to emit support columns, keeping the existing signature (df, te_state) and TE_M=20 smoothing; add TE_SUPPORT_COLS to NUM_FEATS and to LGB_FEATURES, leaving _make_X_lgb and _make_X_cat signatures unchanged. Constraint: no label-dependent computation outside fold-train fitting; FEATURES/CAT_FEATS lists stay the single source of truth for predict.", "model_design": "WHAT: Add one structurally different fourth base learner to the blend — LGBMClassifier/LGBM boosting_type='dart' (drop_rate=0.1, num_leaves=63, min_child_samples=15) trained on the same numeric+TE matrix via lgb.train, keeping CatBoost, LightGBM-GBDT and HGB but demoting HGB to optional since it is the weakest and most correlated with LGB. WHY: current diversity is CatBoost + two histogram-based leafwise learners on the same TE matrix, so the variance floor of the blend is set by redundant errors; DART's drop regularization and a different grow/regularization style decorrelates errors on 8k rows, and the historical success case shows a native-categorical booster plus a differently-regularized booster is what actually moves accuracy. HOW: add DART_PARAMS next to LGB_PARAMS, build_dart() mirroring build_catboost, and fit it inside _fit_cv_models reusing Xl_tr/Xl_va and the fold-internal te_tr/te_fold_state so no leakage is introduced; append 'dart' to oof/iters dicts in _fit_cv_models and to meta_features in train; fit the final dart model on 100% of rows with median CV iterations plus the same 1.10 inflation. Constraint: keep feature_order/cat_features/lgb_cat_features bundle keys and _make_X_lgb unchanged; keep thread_count/num_threads=2 and graceful fallback (has_lgb False -> skip dart, meta_features reduces to ['cat','hgb']) so predict still works from a frozen bundle.", "training_evaluation": "WHAT: (a) tighten the stacker to LogisticRegression(C=0.15) with the persisted inner-CV(5, seed=42) threshold plus a minimum-margin rule (only move off 0.5 if inner-CV mean accuracy beats 0.5 by >=0.002, tie-break toward 0.5), (b) additionally score a fixed-weight logit blend of the base learners on the same inner CV and prefer it whenever it is within 0.002 of the meta-learner (guard against stacker overfitting), and (c) 3-seed bag the final full-data refit (42, 1042, 2042) at fixed median CV iterations with no per-seed early stopping, averaging probabilities in logit space. WHY: the current 891-point OOF sweep and a C=0.5 stacker mix model-selection noise into the operating point — exactly the failure mode of the historical context-stacker experiment — while a 3-seed fixed-iteration refit attacks single-seed variance that dominates 8k-row training. HOW: modify _fit_meta to take the margin rule and return (final_meta, best_thr, inner_acc); in train, compute the fixed-weight blend (e.g. cat 0.4 / lgb 0.3 / dart 0.2 / hgb 0.1, renormalized over available members) alongside the meta path, persist chosen mode as bundle['decision_layer'] ('meta' or 'blend') with its weights, and in predict branch on that key using the same _logit averaging; loop the final CatBoost/LGB/DART/HGB fits over the three seeds reusing the existing build_* helpers and median iteration values. Constraint: preserve bundle keys threshold, classes, meta_features, feature_order, lgb_feature_order, te_state, cat_maps and the row_id,prediction output contract; predict must only load and transform, never refit."}}
